title: Pesanan Kopi Lantai Tujuh
subject: a first-job intern on the seventh floor of a Jakarta office whose only task for three weeks is photocopying, until his supervisor finally trusts him to take and place the whole office's afternoon coffee order
caption: Malang twinkle midwest emo with math-rock guitar work. Two clean, bright electric guitars tapping interlocking arpeggios in odd phrasing, a melodic picked bass moving under them, a busy and tight drum kit with snare rolls and open hats, a short muted trumpet line in the bridge. Dry live-room recording with slight tape hiss and no polish. Earnest male mid-range vocal that cracks into strained shouts on the chorus, gang vocals on the last chorus. 152 BPM, E major. Jittery, self-mocking and quietly proud. No pop-punk power chords chugging, no screamo, no autotune, no synths, no stadium reverb.
lyrics:
[Intro - twinkly tapped guitars, drums crash in]

[Verse 1]
Minggu pertama aku fotokopi
Minggu kedua aku fotokopi
Mesinnya macet, aku yang dimarahi
Kertasnya hangat, cuma dia temanku

[Pre-Chorus]
Mbak Sari bilang sabar itu proses
Aku bilang toner juga

[Chorus]
Tekan lagi, tekan lagi
Seratus lembar, bolak-balik, rangkap tiga
Tiga minggu aku di pojok sini
Nggak ada yang tahu namaku

[Verse 2]
Jumat sore, jam tiga lewat
Mbak Sari panggil, kasih aku ponsel
Kamu yang pesan kopi buat semua
Aku tulis nama kayak tanda tangan kontrak

[Pre-Chorus]
Pak Budi less sugar, Mbak Sari oat
Satu lagi buat aku, boleh, katanya

[Chorus]
Tulis lagi, tulis lagi
Dua belas gelas, nggak ada yang salah
Tiga minggu aku di pojok sini
Hari ini semua tahu namaku

[Bridge - bass and trumpet, half-time]
Nggak ada yang tepuk tangan
Cuma Pak Budi bilang, pas manisnya

[Chorus - gang vocals]
Tekan lagi, tekan lagi
Senin pagi aku fotokopi lagi
Tiga minggu aku di pojok sini
Tapi kopi hari ini aku yang pesan

[Outro - guitars tapping alone, ends on one chord]
